about: Guilds, livery companies, merchant guilds, trading companies, exchanges, coffee houses, banks and merchants' houses of the isles (roadmap C3b, 2026-10-23): the oldest of each with the age claim, how secure it is, and sources with exact quotes (checked by python -m bidb.evidence --check). Entries without coordinates are companies with no single standing place; entries with listed_in are kept in that list and only shown here.

entries.name: St Mary's Guildhall, Coventry
entries.claim: hall of Coventry's merchant guild of St Mary, built 1340-42
entries.evidence: The earliest of the surviving town guildhalls in this list by its building date; the merchant guild merged with three others in 1392.

sources.author: Wikipedia contributors

entries.category: Oldest livery company or craft guild
